reviewer.tool: agent image read tool on the captured PNGs listed below; numeric Debug HDR readback

observations: The generated brdf-probe fixture renders sixteen isolated roles: white/black dielectric, white/gold metal, IOR 1.5/2.0, specular zero/tinted, uncoated/coated/half-coated dielectric, coated metal, emission, coated emission, transmissive and a 0.5-coverage blend control. The profile capture shows all four rows in Studio, Clay and Directional without clipping.

Numeric GPU readback is consistent across 575 checks. White metal's environment BRDF scale is 0.9999 (white-furnace unity); black dielectric 0.0400; IOR 2.0 0.1111 vs IOR 1.5 0.0400; specularFactor 0 reads 0.0000; the tinted specular probe is R>G>B.

Studio and Directional environment-diffuse and environment-specular channels match exactly (delta 0.00) for every probe, proving both modes use the same Fresnel-weighted split-sum IBL. Directional has no second unweighted transmission reflection.

Clearcoat is Fresnel-weighted: the coated probe's base environment specular is lower than the uncoated twin, the coat channel is non-zero on the two coated dielectrics and coated metal, and emission beneath a coat is attenuated (6.91 vs 7.20 linear) but remains above display range.

Environment intensity zero removes every environment-diffuse, environment-specular and coat channel for all probes; every non-emissive pre-tone-map HDR patch is black and the emission probes remain above 1.0.

The flat 0.3 linear diagnostic patch displays exactly [139,139,139] against the CPU NeutralToneMap/SrgbEncode reference [139,139,139], with no hue shift. The coverage-blend probe follows the documented display composite: linear scene -> tone map -> display-space blend over the backdrop.

Car keeps red paint/dark glass separation and its known windshield/roof ordering and directional brightness; Camera keeps the dark black body and a lens with visible reflection/depth in Studio and Directional. Clay is a coherent opaque form in both assets.

Channel images confirm the intended separation: environment specular is metal-dominated, the coat channel isolates only coated probes, the BRDF-scale channel shows F0/F90 differences, and the transmission-composite channel shows alpha/glassFresnel/transmission separately.

defects.label: limitation
defects.description: Transmission still uses the alpha-carried interface Fresnel and no transmitted-scene sampling. Channel 22 exposes (alpha, glassReflectance, transmission) so the approximation is recorded rather than hidden.

defects.label: known-defect
defects.description: Car windshield/side-glass ordering and bright directional reflection remain T26/T27 work; T24 only establishes the shared BRDF/IBL and Fresnel-weighted layering.

defects.label: limitation
defects.description: The Camera lens keeps its dark reflection/depth; the transmitted scene/tint is not yet sampled. This is the T27 target.

defects.label: limitation
defects.description: The independent uniform-quadrature LUT/prefilter reference is finite-sampled below roughness ~0.4; production importance sampling covers that range and the white-furnace identity is checked separately.

positives: The DFG LUT, GGX prefilter and solid-angle SH projection are baked on the CPU and checked against independent uniform-quadrature references, not a copy of the production formula.
Per-texel cubemap solid angles sum exactly to 4*pi; constant and rotated directional environments match the sphere reference.
KHR_materials_specular keeps F0 (IOR*color) and F90 (specularFactor) independent at normal and grazing incidence.
Clearcoat uses the Khronos c*Fresnel mix and no longer removes a flat (1-clearcoatFactor) of the base specular; base diffuse/specular and emission are all attenuated consistently.
The material shader writes linear HDR only; the resolve pass is the single tone-map/sRGB display encoding. CPU/GPU tone-map agreement and neutral hue are measured numerically.
Release still rejects every test-control message; all new defects are Debug-field reads inside the existing --app-smoke guard.
